_note: Affinities a prime vestige can carry (design/01: a prime delivers a talent and 1+ affinities; more affinities is rarer and worth more). Brent 2026-10-11: fire, earth, wind and lightning beside water. Affinities are NOT tied to the talent - they decide which skills you can learn and are rolled separately when a prime is offered (see balance.json 'primes' and PrimeRoll). prime_default is only what a character gets when nothing was rolled (tests, bots, old saves). 'kit' is the three abilities a character with that affinity starts with: a ranged attack, a melee strike, a movement skill. Labels, descriptions and kits are ours [MODEL]. reflux_shed_mult_combat scales how fast that affinity's reflux sheds while something is trying to kill you (lightning: 0 - only an Overload grounds it). damage_per_reflux (fire's Heat, design/05 2.2): every hit tagged with that affinity is multiplied by 1 + damage_per_reflux x its reflux / 100, so the reflux ring is a second damage bar.

water.label: Water
water.desc: You decide where everyone stands. Every skill shoves, and what is shoved into something breaks on it.

fire.label: Fire
fire.desc: You get hotter, and so does everything near you. Your own heat is your damage - right up to the moment it locks.

earth.label: Earth
earth.desc: Slow, heavy and sure. Nothing arrives fast, and nothing it hits stays standing.

wind.label: Wind
wind.desc: Light and far-reaching. Small costs, long reach, and you are never where you were.

lightning.label: Lightning
lightning.desc: One target, three touches, gone. Its heat does not bleed off in a fight - only finishing a target grounds it.
